source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) The Info‑communications Media Development Authority is designated as the Personal Data Protection Commission.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) The Personal Data Protection Commission is responsible for the administration of this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) to promote awareness of data protection in Singapore;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b

source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) to advise the Government on all matters relating to data protection;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) to represent the Government internationally on matters relating to data protection;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: e
text: (e) to conduct research and studies and promote educational activities relating to data protection, including organising and conducting seminars, workshops and symposia relating thereto, and supporting other organisations conducting such activities;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: f
text: (f) to manage technical cooperation and exchange in the area of data protection with other organisations, including foreign data protection authorities and international or inter‑governmental organisations, on its own behalf or on behalf of the Government;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: g
text: (g) to administer and enforce this Act;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: h
text: (h) to carry out functions conferred on the Commission under any other written law; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) to engage in such other activities and perform such functions as the Minister may permit or assign to the Commission by order in the Gazette.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) The Minister may appoint one or more advisory committees to provide advice to the Commission with regard to the performance of any of its functions under this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) The Commission may consult such advisory committees in relation to the performance of its functions and duties and the exercise of its powers under this Act but is not bound by such consultation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) The Commission may appoint, by name or office, from among public officers and the employees of the Authority —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (b) such number of Deputy Commissioners for Personal Data Protection, Assistant Commissioners for Personal Data Protection and inspectors, as the Commission considers necessary.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) Where any function, duty or power of the Commission under this Act is delegated to the Commissioner under section 38 of the Info‑communications Media Development Authority Act 2016 —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a

label: c

source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) An individual appointed under section 8(1) or an employee of the Authority, who is authorised in writing by the Chief Executive of the Authority for the purpose of this section, may conduct, with the authorisation of the Public Prosecutor, proceedings in respect of an offence under this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) A legal counsel of the Commission who is an advocate and solicitor may —

label: b

source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) For the purposes of section 59, a cooperation agreement is an agreement for the purposes of —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) facilitating cooperation between the Commission and another regulatory authority in the performance of their respective functions in so far as those functions relate to data protection; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) avoiding duplication of activities by the Commission and another regulatory authority, being activities involving the enforcement of data protection laws.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) A cooperation agreement may include provisions —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (a) to enable the Commission and the other regulatory authority to provide to each other information in their respective possession if the information is required by the other for the purpose of performance by it of any of its functions;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) to provide such other assistance to each other as will facilitate the performance by the other of any of its functions; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) to enable the Commission and the other regulatory authority to forbear to perform any of their respective functions in relation to a matter in circumstances where it is satisfied that the other is performing functions in relation to that matter.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) The Commission must not provide any information to a foreign data protection body pursuant to a cooperation agreement unless it requires of, and obtains from, that body an undertaking in writing by it that it will comply with terms specified in that requirement, including terms that correspond to the provisions of any written law concerning the disclosure of that information by the Commission.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) The Commission may give an undertaking to a foreign data protection body that it will comply with terms specified in a requirement made of the Commission by the foreign data protection body to give such an undertaking where —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) those terms correspond to the provisions of any law in force in the country or territory in which the foreign data protection body is established, being provisions which concern the disclosure by the foreign data protection body of the information mentioned in paragraph (b); and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) compliance with the requirement is a condition imposed by the foreign data protection body for providing information in its possession to the Commission pursuant to a cooperation agreement.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) In this section —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) In meeting its responsibilities under this Act, an organisation must consider what a reasonable person would consider appropriate in the circumstances.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) An organisation is responsible for personal data in its possession or under its control.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) An organisation must designate one or more individuals to be responsible for ensuring that the organisation complies with this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) An individual designated under subsection (3) may delegate to another individual the responsibility conferred by that designation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) An organisation must make available to the public the business contact information of at least one of the individuals designated under subsection (3) or delegated under subsection (4).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: 5A
text: (5A) Without limiting subsection (5), an organisation is deemed to have satisfied that subsection if the organisation makes available the business contact information of any individual mentioned in subsection (3) in any prescribed manner.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (6) The designation of an individual by an organisation under subsection (3) does not relieve the organisation of any of its obligations under this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) develop and implement policies and practices that are necessary for the organisation to meet the obligations of the organisation under this Act;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) develop a process to receive and respond to complaints that may arise with respect to the application of this Act;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) communicate to its staff information about the organisation’s policies and practices mentioned in paragraph (a); and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) make information available on request about —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) the policies and practices mentioned in paragraph (a); and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) the complaint process mentioned in paragraph (b).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the individual gives, or is deemed to have given, his or her consent under this Act to the collection, use or disclosure, as the case may be; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the collection, use or disclosure (as the case may be) without the individual’s consent is required or authorised under this Act or any other written law.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) An individual has not given consent under this Act for the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about the individual by an organisation for a purpose unless —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the individual has been provided with the information required under section 20; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the individual provided his or her consent for that purpose in accordance with this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) An organisation must not —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) as a condition of providing a product or service, require an individual to consent to the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about the individual beyond what is reasonable to provide the product or service to that individual; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) obtain or attempt to obtain consent for collecting, using or disclosing personal data by providing false or misleading information with respect to the collection, use or disclosure of the personal data, or using deceptive or misleading practices.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Any consent given in any of the circumstances in subsection (2) is not validly given for the purposes of this Act.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) In this Act, references to consent given, or deemed to have been given, by an individual for the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about the individual include consent given, or deemed to have been given, by any person validly acting on that individual’s behalf for the collection, use or disclosure of such personal data.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) An individual is deemed to consent to the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about the individual by an organisation for a purpose if —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the individual, without actually giving consent mentioned in section 14, voluntarily provides the personal data to the organisation for that purpose; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) it is reasonable that the individual would voluntarily provide the data.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) If an individual gives, or is deemed to have given, consent to the disclosure of personal data about the individual by one organisation to another organisation for a particular purpose, the individual is deemed to consent to the collection, use or disclosure of the personal data for that particular purpose by that other organisation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Without limiting subsection (2) and subject to subsection (9), an individual (P) who provides personal data to an organisation (A) with a view to P entering into a contract with A is deemed to consent to the following where reasonably necessary for the conclusion of the contract between P and A:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the disclosure of that personal data by A to another organisation (B);
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the collection and use of that personal data by B;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) the disclosure of that personal data by B to another organisation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) Where an organisation collects personal data disclosed to it by B under subsection (3)(c), subsection (3)(b) and (c) applies to the organisation as if the personal data were disclosed by A to the organisation under subsection (3)(a).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) Subsections (3) and (4) apply to personal data provided before 1 February 2021 by an individual to an organisation with a view to the individual entering into a contract with the organisation — as if subsections (3) and (4) —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) on or after 1 February 2021; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) which contract was entered into before 1 February 2021 and remains in force on that date,
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) were in force when the personal data was so provided; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) had continued in force until 1 February 2021.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (6) Without limiting subsection (2) and subject to subsection (9), an individual (P) who enters into a contract with an organisation (A) and provides personal data to A pursuant or in relation to that contract is deemed to consent to the following:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the disclosure of that personal data by A to another organisation (B), where the disclosure is reasonably necessary —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) for the performance of the contract between P and A; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) for the conclusion or performance of a contract between A and B which is entered into at P’s request, or which a reasonable person would consider to be in P’s interest;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the collection and use of that personal data by B, where the collection and use are reasonably necessary for any purpose mentioned in paragraph (a);
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) the disclosure of that personal data by B to another organisation, where the disclosure is reasonably necessary for any purpose mentioned in paragraph (a).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (7) Where an organisation collects personal data disclosed to it by B under subsection (6)(c), subsection (6)(b) and (c) applies to the organisation as if the personal data were disclosed by A to the organisation under subsection (6)(a).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (8) Subsections (6) and (7) apply to personal data provided before 1 February 2021 by an individual to an organisation in relation to a contract that the individual entered into before that date with the organisation, and which remains in force on that date, as if subsections (6) and (7) —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) were in force when the personal data was so provided; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) had continued in force until 1 February 2021.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (9) Subsections (3), (4), (5), (6), (7) and (8) do not affect any obligation under the contract between P and A that specifies or restricts —

text: (1) This section applies to the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about an individual by an organisation on or after 1 February 2021.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) Subject to subsection (3), an individual is deemed to consent to the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about the individual by an organisation if —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the organisation satisfies the requirements in subsection (4); and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (b) the individual does not notify the organisation, before the expiry of the period mentioned in subsection (4)(b)(iii), that the individual does not consent to the proposed collection, use or disclosure of the personal data by the organisation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Subsection (2) does not apply to the collection, use or disclosure of personal data about the individual for any prescribed purpose.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) For the purposes of subsection (2)(a), the organisation must, before collecting, using or disclosing any personal data about the individual —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) conduct an assessment to determine that the proposed collection, use or disclosure of the personal data is not likely to have an adverse effect on the individual;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) take reasonable steps to bring the following information to the attention of the individual:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) the organisation’s intention to collect, use or disclose the personal data;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) the purpose for which the personal data will be collected, used or disclosed;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: iii
text: (iii) a reasonable period within which, and a reasonable manner by which, the individual may notify the organisation that the individual does not consent to the organisation’s proposed collection, use or disclosure of the personal data; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) satisfy any other prescribed requirements.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) The organisation must, in respect of the assessment mentioned in subsection (4)(a) —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) identify any adverse effect that the proposed collection, use or disclosure of the personal data for the purpose concerned is likely to have on the individual;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) identify and implement reasonable measures to —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) eliminate the adverse effect;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) reduce the likelihood that the adverse effect will occur; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the nature, gravity and duration of the non‑compliance by the organisation or person, as the case may be;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the type and nature of the personal data affected by the non‑compliance by the organisation or person, as the case may be;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) whether the organisation or person (as the case may be), as a result of the non‑compliance, gained any financial benefit or avoided any financial loss;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) whether the organisation or person (as the case may be) took any action to mitigate the effects and consequences of the non‑compliance, and the timeliness and effectiveness of that action;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: e
text: (e) whether the organisation or person (as the case may be) had, despite the non‑compliance, implemented adequate and appropriate measures for compliance with the requirements under this Act;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: f
text: (f) whether the organisation or person (as the case may be) had previously failed to comply with this Act;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: g
text: (g) the compliance of the organisation or person (as the case may be) with any direction given under section 48I or 48L(4) in relation to remedying or mitigating the effect of the non‑compliance;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: h
text: (h) whether the financial penalty to be imposed is proportionate and effective, having regard to achieving compliance and deterring non‑compliance with this Act;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) the likely impact of the imposition of the financial penalty on the organisation or person (as the case may be), including the ability of the organisation or person to continue the usual activities of the organisation or person;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: j
text: (j) any other matter that may be relevant.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) Before giving any direction under section 48I or imposing a financial penalty under section 48J(1), the Commission must give written notice to the organisation or person concerned —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) stating that the Commission intends to take action against the organisation or person under section 48I or 48J(1), as the case may be;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) where the Commission intends to give any direction under section 48I, specifying the direction the Commission proposes to give;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) specifying each instance of non‑compliance that is the subject of the proposed action, or the reason or reasons for the proposed action; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) subject to subsections (2) and (3), specifying the time within which written representations may be made to the Commission with respect to the proposed action.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) Where the Commission intends to impose a financial penalty under section 48J(1) on an organisation or a person, the time specified in the notice within which written representations may be made to the Commission must be at least 14 days after the date the notice is served on that organisation or person.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) The Commission may, on written application by the organisation or person concerned (whether before, on or after the expiry of the time specified in the notice), extend the time for the organisation or person to make written representations to the Commission if the Commission is satisfied that the extension should be granted by reason of exceptional circumstances in the particular case.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) The Commission may decide to give the direction under section 48I or impose the financial penalty under section 48J(1), as the case may be —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) after considering any written representation made to the Commission pursuant to the notice mentioned in subsection (1); or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) upon the expiry of the time specified in the notice under subsection (1)(d), or as extended by the Commission under subsection (3), where no representation is so made or any written representation made is subsequently withdrawn.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) Subsection (1) does not apply where the organisation or person (as the case may be) has died, is adjudged bankrupt, has been dissolved or wound up or has otherwise ceased to exist.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (6) Where the Commission decides to give the direction under section 48I or impose the financial penalty under section 48J(1) (as the case may be), the Commission must serve a notice of the decision on the following persons:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the organisation or person concerned;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the complainant whose complaint against the organisation or person concerned resulted in the giving of the direction or the imposition of the financial penalty (as the case may be), if any.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (7) A direction given under section 48I or the imposition of a financial penalty under section 48J(1) takes effect only when the Commission serves the notice in subsection (6)(a) on the organisation or person concerned.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (8) Where the Commission imposes a financial penalty under section 48J(1) on an organisation or a person, the written notice issued by the Commission to the organisation or person must specify the date before which the financial penalty is to be paid, being a date not earlier than 28 days after the notice is issued.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (9) The Commission may, on written application by an organisation or a person on whom a financial penalty under section 48J(1) is imposed —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) extend the time for the organisation or person to pay the financial penalty; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) allow the financial penalty to be paid by instalments.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (10) The interest payable — must be at such rate as the Commission may direct, which must not exceed the rate prescribed in the Rules of Court in respect of judgment debts.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) on the outstanding amount of any financial penalty imposed under section 48J(1); and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) for payment by instalments (as the Commission may allow) of any financial penalty imposed under section 48J(1),
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) Without affecting sections 48I, 48J(1) and 50(1), where the Commission has reasonable grounds to believe that — the organisation or person concerned may give, and the Commission may accept, a written voluntary undertaking.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) an organisation has not complied, is not complying or is likely not to comply with any provision of Part 3, 4, 5, 6, 6A or 6B; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) a person has not complied, is not complying or is likely not to comply with any provision of Part 9 or section 48B(1),
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) Without limiting the matters to which the voluntary undertaking may relate, the voluntary undertaking may include any of the following undertakings by the organisation or person concerned:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) an undertaking to take specified action within a specified time;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) an undertaking to refrain from taking specified action;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) an undertaking to publicise the voluntary undertaking.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Subject to subsection (4), the Commission may, after accepting the voluntary undertaking and with the agreement of the organisation or person who gave the voluntary undertaking —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) vary the terms of any undertaking included in the voluntary undertaking; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) include, in the voluntary undertaking, any additional undertaking mentioned in subsection (2).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) Where an organisation or a person fails to comply with any undertaking in a voluntary undertaking —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the Commission may give the organisation or person concerned any direction that the Commission thinks fit in the circumstances to ensure the compliance of the organisation or person with that undertaking; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) section 48K(1), (3), (4), (5), (6) and (7) applies to the direction given under paragraph (a) as if the direction were given under section 48I.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) In addition, where an organisation or a person fails to comply with an undertaking mentioned in subsection (2)(c), the Commission may publicise the voluntary undertaking in accordance with the undertaking, and recover the costs and expenses so incurred from the organisation or person as a debt due to the Commission.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) For the purposes of enforcing a direction or written notice mentioned in subsection (2) —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the Commission may apply for the direction or written notice (as the case may be) to be registered in a District Court in accordance with the Rules of Court; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the District Court is to register the direction or written notice in accordance with the Rules of Court.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) Subsection (1) applies to any of the following:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) a direction made by the Commission under section 48H(2), 48I or 48L(4);
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) a written notice by the Commission for the payment of any sum comprising —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) a financial penalty imposed under section 48J(1); and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) any interest payable under section 48K(10) on that financial penalty.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) From the date of registration of a direction or written notice under subsection (1), the direction or written notice (as the case may be) has the same force and effect, and all proceedings may be taken on the direction or written notice (as the case may be), for the purposes of enforcement, as if it had been an order originally obtained in the District Court which has power to enforce it accordingly.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) A District Court may, for the purpose of enforcing a direction in accordance with subsection (3), make any order —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) to secure compliance with the direction; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) to require any person to do anything to remedy, mitigate or eliminate any effects arising from — (b) which would not have occurred had the direction been
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) anything done which ought not, under the direction, to have been done; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) anything not done which ought, under the direction, to have been done, complied with.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) A District Court has jurisdiction to enforce a written notice in accordance with subsection (3) regardless of the amount of the sum mentioned in subsection (2)(b).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) An organisation or a person (including any individual who is a complainant) aggrieved by — may make a written application to the Commission to reconsider the direction or decision in accordance with this section.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) any direction made by the Commission under section 48G(2), 48I(1) or (2) or 48L(4); or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) any direction or decision made under section 48H(2),
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) An organisation or a person aggrieved by a financial penalty imposed by the Commission under section 48J(1) on the organisation or person may make a written application to the Commission to reconsider the decision to impose the financial penalty or the amount of the financial penalty so imposed in accordance with this section.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Unless the Commission decides otherwise in any particular case, an application for reconsideration does not suspend the effect of the direction or decision to be reconsidered except in the case of an application for reconsideration under subsection (2).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) The application for reconsideration —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) subject to subsection (5), must be submitted to the Commission within the prescribed period;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) must be made in the form and manner required by the Commission; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) must set out the grounds on which the applicant is requesting the reconsideration.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) The Commission may, on written application by the organisation or person concerned (whether before, on or after the expiry of the prescribed period mentioned in subsection (4)(a)), extend the time for the organisation or person to make the application for reconsideration if the Commission is satisfied that the extension should be granted by reason of exceptional circumstances in the particular case.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (6) If an application for reconsideration is made in accordance with this section, the Commission must —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) reconsider the direction or decision;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) take any of the following actions as the Commission thinks fit:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) affirm, revoke or vary the direction or decision;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) affirm or revoke, or vary the amount of, the financial penalty; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) notify the applicant in writing of the result of the reconsideration.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (7) There is to be no application for reconsideration of a decision made under subsection (6)(b).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) A person who suffers loss or damage directly as a result of a contravention — has a right of action for relief in civil proceedings in a court.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) by an organisation of any provision of Part 4, 5, 6, 6A or 6B; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) by a person of any provision of Division 3 of Part 9 or section 48B(1),
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) If the Commission has made a decision under this Act in respect of a contravention specified in subsection (1), an action accruing under subsection (1) may not be brought in respect of that contravention until after the decision has become final as a result of there being no further right of appeal.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) The court may grant to the claimant in an action under subsection (1) all or any of the following:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) relief by way of injunction or declaration;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) damages;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) any other relief as the court thinks fit.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) There is established a Data Protection Appeal Panel.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) The Minister must appoint the members of the Appeal Panel.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) The Chairperson of the Appeal Panel must be appointed by the Minister from among the members of the Appeal Panel.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) For the purpose of hearing any appeal under section 48Q, the Chairperson of the Appeal Panel may nominate a Data Protection Appeal Committee comprising 3 or more members of the Appeal Panel.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) The Seventh Schedule has effect with respect to the Appeal Panel, Appeal Committees and their members and the proceedings of Appeal Committees, as the case may be.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) An organisation or a person (including an individual who is a complainant) aggrieved by — may, within the prescribed period, appeal to the Chairperson of the Appeal Panel against that direction or decision.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) any direction made by the Commission under section 48G(2), 48I(1) or (2) or 48L(4);
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) any direction or decision made by the Commission under section 48H(2); or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) any decision made by the Commission under section 48N(6)(b),
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) An organisation or a person aggrieved by a financial penalty imposed by the Commission under section 48J(1) on the organisation or person may, within the prescribed period, appeal to the Chairperson of the Appeal Panel against the decision to impose the financial penalty or the amount of the financial penalty so imposed.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Where an application for reconsideration has been made under section 48N, every appeal in respect of the same direction or decision which is the subject of the application for reconsideration is deemed to be withdrawn.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) Unless the Appeal Committee decides otherwise in any particular case, the making of an appeal under this section does not suspend the effect of the direction or decision to which the appeal relates except in the case of an appeal under subsection (2).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) An Appeal Committee hearing an appeal may confirm, vary or set aside the direction or decision which is the subject of the appeal and, in particular, may —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) remit the matter to the Commission;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) impose or revoke, or vary the amount of, a financial penalty;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) give any direction, or take any other step, that the Commission could itself have given or taken; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) make any other direction or decision that the Commission could itself have made.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (6) A direction or decision of an Appeal Committee on an appeal has the same effect, and may be enforced in the same manner, as a direction or decision of the Commission, except that there is to be no application for further reconsideration under section 48N and no further appeal under this section from the direction or decision of the Appeal Committee.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (7) If an Appeal Committee confirms the direction or decision which is the subject of the appeal, it may nevertheless set aside any finding of fact on which the direction or decision was based.

source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (b) from any direction of the Appeal Committee as to the amount of a financial penalty.

text: (2) An appeal under this section may be made within the prescribed time only at the instance of —

source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) There is such further right of appeal from decisions of the General Division of the High Court under this section as exists in the case of decisions made by the General Division of the High Court in the exercise of its original civil jurisdiction.

text: (1) The Commission may issue written advisory guidelines indicating the manner in which the Commission will interpret the provisions of this Act.
