text: (g) any message sent to an organisation other than an individual acting in a personal or domestic capacity, for any purpose of the receiving organisation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) In sub‑paragraph (1)(e), “ongoing relationship” means a relationship, on an ongoing basis, between the sender and the recipient of the message, arising from the carrying on or conduct of a business or an activity (commercial or otherwise) by the sender.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) For the purposes of an investigation under section 50, the Commission or an inspector may, by written notice to any organisation, require the organisation to produce to the Commission or the inspector a specified document or specified information, which the Commission or inspector considers relates to any matter relevant to such investigation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) A notice under sub‑paragraph (1) must indicate the purpose for which the specified document or specified information is required by the Commission.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) The Commission may specify in the notice —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) the time and place at which any document is to be produced or any information is to be provided; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) the manner and form in which it is to be produced or provided.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) The power under this paragraph to require an organisation to produce a document includes the power —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) if the document is produced —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) to take copies of it or extracts from it; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) to require the organisation, or any person who is a present or past officer of the organisation, or is or was at any time employed by the organisation, to provide an explanation of the document; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) if the document is not produced, to require the organisation or person to state, to the best of the organisation’s or person’s knowledge and belief, where it is.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) In sub‑paragraphs (1) and (2), “specified” means —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) specified or described in the notice; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) falling within a category which is specified or described in the notice.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) For the purposes of an investigation under section 50, the Commission or an inspector may do all or any of the following:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) require, by written notice, any person whom the Commission or inspector reasonably believes has any information, or any document in the person’s custody or control, that is relevant to the investigation, to provide that information or produce that document, within the time and in the manner specified in the written notice;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) require, by written notice, any person within the limits of Singapore, who appears to be acquainted with the facts or circumstances of the matter, to attend before the Commission or inspector;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) examine orally any person who appears to be acquainted with the facts or circumstances of the matter.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) A person examined under sub‑paragraph (1)(c) is bound to state truly the facts and circumstances with which the person is acquainted concerning the matter except that the person need not say anything that might expose the person to a criminal charge, penalty or forfeiture.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) A statement made by a person examined under sub‑paragraph (1)(c) must —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) be reduced to writing;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) be read over to the person;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) if the person does not understand English, be interpreted in a language that the person understands; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) after correction (if necessary), be signed by the person.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) In connection with an investigation under section 50, an inspector, and such other persons as the inspector may require to assist him or her, may enter any premises.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) An inspector or a person assisting the inspector must not enter any premises in exercise of the powers under this paragraph unless the inspector has given the occupier of the premises a written notice which —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) gives at least 2 working days’ notice of the intended entry; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) indicates the subject matter and purpose of the investigation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) Sub‑paragraph (2) does not apply if the inspector has reasonable grounds for suspecting that the premises are, or have been, occupied by an organisation which is being investigated in relation to a contravention of this Act and if the inspector has taken all such steps as are reasonably practicable to give written notice under that sub‑paragraph but has not been able to do so.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) Where sub‑paragraph (3) applies, the power of entry conferred by sub‑paragraph (1) shall be exercised upon production of —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) evidence of the inspector’s appointment; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) a document containing the information referred to in sub‑paragraph (2)(b).
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) An inspector or a person assisting the inspector entering any premises under this paragraph may —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) take with him or her such equipment as appears to him or her to be necessary;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) require any person on the premises —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) to produce any document which he or she considers relates to any matter relevant to the investigation; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) if the document is produced, to provide an explanation of it;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) require any person to state, to the best of the person’s knowledge and belief, where any such document is to be found;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) take copies of, or extracts from, any document which is produced;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: e
text: (e) require any information which is stored in any electronic form and is accessible from the premises and which he or she considers relates to any matter relevant to the investigation, to be produced in a form —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) in which it can be taken away; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) in which it is visible and legible; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: f
text: (f) take any step which appears to be necessary for the purpose of preserving or preventing interference with any document which he or she considers relates to any matter relevant to the investigation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (1) The Commission or any inspector may apply to a court for a warrant and the court may issue such a warrant if it is satisfied that —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that there are, on any premises, documents —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) the production of which has been required under paragraph 1 or 2; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) which have not been produced as required;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) there are, on any premises, documents which the Commission or the inspector has power under paragraph 1 to require to be produced; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) if the documents were required to be produced, they would not be produced but would be concealed, removed, tampered with or destroyed; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) an inspector or a person assisting the inspector has attempted to enter the premises in the exercise of his or her powers under paragraph 2 but has been unable to do so and that there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that there are, on the premises, documents the production of which could have been required under that paragraph.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (2) A warrant under this paragraph authorises a named officer, and such other persons as the inspector may require to assist him or her, to do all or any of the following:
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) to enter the premises specified in the warrant, using such force as is reasonably necessary for the purpose;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) to search any person on those premises if there are reasonable grounds for believing that that person has in his or her possession any document, equipment or article which has a bearing on the investigation;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: c
text: (c) to search the premises and take copies of, or extracts from, any document appearing to be of a kind in respect of which the application under sub‑paragraph (1) was granted (the relevant kind);
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: d
text: (d) to take possession of any document appearing to be of the relevant kind if —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) such action appears to be necessary for preserving the document or preventing interference with it; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) it is not reasonably practicable to take copies of the document on the premises;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: e
text: (e) to take any other step which appears to be necessary for the purpose mentioned in sub‑paragraph (d)(i);
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: f
text: (f) to require any person to provide an explanation of any document appearing to be of the relevant kind or to state, to the best of the person’s knowledge and belief, where it may be found;
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: g
text: (g) to require any information which is stored in any electronic form and is accessible from the premises and which he or she considers relates to any matter relevant to the investigation, to be produced in a form —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: i
text: (i) in which it can be taken away; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: ii
text: (ii) in which it is visible and legible; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: h
text: (h) to remove from those premises for examination any equipment or article which relates to any matter relevant to the investigation.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (3) If, in the case of a warrant under sub‑paragraph (1)(b), the court is satisfied that it is reasonable to suspect that there are also on the premises other documents relating to the investigation concerned, the warrant also authorises the actions mentioned in sub‑paragraph (2) to be taken in relation to any such document.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (4) Where possession of any document is taken under sub‑paragraph (2)(d) or (3), the named officer may, at the request of the person from whom possession of the document was taken, provide such person with a copy of the document.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (5) A named officer may allow any equipment or article which has a bearing on an investigation and which may be removed from any premises for examination under sub‑paragraph (2)(h) to be retained on those premises subject to such conditions as the named officer may require.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (6) A warrant issued under this paragraph —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) must indicate the subject matter and purpose of the investigation; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) continues in force until the end of one month beginning from the day on which it is issued.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (7) The powers conferred by this paragraph must not be exercised except upon production of a warrant issued under this paragraph.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (8) A person entering any premises by virtue of a warrant under this paragraph may take with the person such equipment as appears to the person to be necessary.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (9) If there is no one at the premises when the named officer proposes to execute such a warrant, the named officer must, before executing it —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) take such steps as are reasonable in all the circumstances to inform the occupier of the intended entry; and
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) if the occupier is informed, give the occupier or the occupier’s legal or other representative a reasonable opportunity to be present when the warrant is executed.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (10) If the named officer is unable to inform the occupier of the intended entry, the named officer must, when executing the warrant, leave a copy of the warrant in a prominent place on the premises.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (11) On leaving any premises which the named officer has entered by virtue of a warrant under this paragraph, the named officer must, if the premises are unoccupied or the occupier is temporarily absent, leave them as effectively secured as the named officer found them.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (12) Any document of which possession is taken under sub‑paragraph (2)(d) or (3) may be retained for a period of not more than 3 months.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

text: (13) In this paragraph —
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: a
text: (a) in the possession or under the control of the organisation or public agency; or
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf

label: b
text: (b) transmitted or received by the organisation or public agency.
source_document: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (2020 Revised Edition) — KB 2/Singapore/Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).pdf
